root_cause_analysis.symptom: User-visible markdown features [text][ref], [^1], <mark>, <sub>, <sup>, <abbr>, <details> render as literal text instead of formatted output. Reference link definition lines [ref]: url and footnote definitions [^1]: body leak as visible text rather than being captured into per-message lookup tables.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: parseMarkdownSpans.ts has consumers only for: code spans (`), <kbd>, $...$, $$...$$, ~~strike~~, ***bold-italic***, **bold**, *italic*, [text](url) inline-link. No reference-link consumer. No footnote consumer. No HTML tag handlers other than <kbd>. parseMarkdownBlock.ts has no def-collection pre-pass for [ref]: url or [^label]: body. parseMarkdownBlock.ts has no <details> block handler. Render layer (MarkdownView.tsx) has no style entries for mark/sub/sup/abbr/footnote-ref and no collapsible disclosure component for details.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — these are missing-feature bugs, not regressions. Static read of parseMarkdownSpans.ts:159-168 (consumeToken) and parseMarkdownBlock.ts:263-278 (parseSingleLine) confirms no code path exists for the 3 catalog items. Cycle 7 completion-20260509-152243.md line 76 records intentional deferral.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original parser scope (pre-Cycle-1) did not include reference-style links, footnotes, or non-kbd HTML inline elements. Cycle 1 BA narrowed to #5/#5b/#12 only. Cycle 7 codex iter-1 explicitly downsized Phase B from 4 parser items to 1 (B3 #13 only) due to concurrent regression risk in parseMarkdownSpans.ts.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Markdown authors expect reference-style links and footnotes per CommonMark/GFM/Pandoc precedent. <mark>/<sub>/<sup>/<abbr>/<details> are HTML primitives with no clean markdown alternative. Authors reach for them and get literal text — silent failure, no warning.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Original: feature gaps from initial parser. Cycle 1 (2026-05-06): #5/#5b/#12 fixed; #10/#11/#9 deferred. Cycle 7 (2026-05-09): codex iter-1 forced 4-parser concurrent into 1; #10/#11/#9 deferred again to Cycle 8 — Parser slice. Cycle 8 (2026-05-09 this cycle): saga closer.
